title: Trip Charge on Collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visits — Posting Reference
content:
## The charge

A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of **Specimen Collection Appointments** that has been collected carries a trip charge for the phlebotomist's trip to the patient's home. The trip charge on a collected home visit is worked out by calculation rather than read straight off the published zone fee. It is posted on the visit as one assessed trip fee, dated the day it is posted; from then the visit's fee history shows the assessed trip fee and the patient owes it until it is settled. A visit carries at most one trip fee.

## Posting tool: `assess_trip_fee_73c5b19a`

**Capability.** Posts the trip charge on a collected home (mobile in-home) collection visit. One call adds one assessed trip-fee line, dated today, to the visit's collection-service fee record and raises the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance by that amount.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_trip_fee_73c5b19a` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `visit_id` | The reference number of the collection visit the trip charge belongs to, as read from the visit lookup for the patient | Identifier |
| `fee_amount` | The trip charge to post, in USD | A positive amount given to 2 decimal places (cents); posted exactly as given, already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with:

- `visit_event_id` — the reference number of the new assessed trip-fee line;
- `visit_id` — the visit charged;
- `fee_type` — always `trip_fee`;
- `fee_amount` — the amount posted in USD, to 2 decimal places;
- `event_date` — today's posting date, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `fee_balance` — the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance in USD after posting.

A receipt carrying a `visit_event_id` means the charge is on the visit.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `visit_id` set to an invented visit reference and `fee_amount` 101.20 returns a receipt whose `fee_type` is `trip_fee`, whose `fee_amount` is 101.20 and whose `fee_balance` is the visit's earlier outstanding balance raised by 101.20. The amount is an illustrative input only, not a rate of the company.
